title: View reports on Local Services Ads - Local Services Help

facts.fact: The Mark Booked lead-tracking feature is currently available only in the U.S. and Canada.
facts.quote: Note: This feature is currently only available in the U.S. and Canada.

facts.fact: Local Services Ads reports show the total amount charged to the advertiser during a selected date range.
facts.quote: The total amount you were charged during this period

facts.fact: Local Services Ads reports show the number of charged leads received from potential customers who saw the ad on Google search results pages.
facts.quote: The number of charged leads that you received in the period from potential customers who saw your ad on Google search results pages.

facts.fact: Local Services Ads reports show the amount of lead credits received during a selected period.
facts.quote: The amount of lead credits you received during this period

facts.fact: Google states that advertisers under Local Services Ads pay only when a customer gets in touch from the ad.
facts.quote: only pay when a customer gets in touch from your ad.

facts.fact: The Local Services API is positioned by Google for MCC managers with multiple managed Local Services Ads accounts, and Google describes it as best suited for large companies managing multiple accounts.
facts.quote: It is best suited for large companies managing multiple Local Services Ads accounts.
